bead.title: review: runtime loop and loop-detection (AR-2026-04-12)
bead.description:
Review area: runtime loop, event emission, compaction, and loop-detection behavior as of v0.3.1.

Key delta since AR-2026-04-10: ErrReasoningOverflow, ErrReasoningStall, ErrToolCallLoop are all implemented in loop.go, errors.go, and stream_consume.go and merged in v0.3.1. The two open beads (agent-7f1dec9b, agent-cf7e4cc8) describing this work are stale — implementation predates the alignment review.

Finding: FEAT-001 acceptance criteria (AC-FEAT-001-01 through AC-FEAT-001-06) do not cover loop-detection behaviors. The three error sentinels (ErrReasoningOverflow, ErrReasoningStall, ErrToolCallLoop) and their corresponding loop exit paths are implemented and tested but have no governing acceptance criterion in FEAT-001. This is INCOMPLETE at the planning layer: implementation exists but no AC traces to it.
bead.acceptance: Gap classified; execution issue filed if non-ALIGNED
